<image>In $\odot R, S U=20, Y W=20,$ and $m \widehat{Y X}=45$.
Find SV
ready1_open_rewrite.title: Geometry3K open-ended question

ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure is a circle with R as the center. S and U are on the circle, and SU is a chord; point V is located on chord SU. The line segment RV drawn from the center R intersects chord SU at V, and there is a right-angle mark at V, indicating that RV is perpendicular to SU. Reasoning: In a circle, a perpendicular drawn from the center to a chord bisects the chord. Therefore V is the midpoint of SU. Given SU = 20, so SV = SU/2 = 20/2 = 10.

Therefore V is the midpoint of SU, so SV = SU/2 = 10.

method.method_draft: From the image, see that S and U are points on the circle, R is the center, V lies on chord SU, and RV is perpendicular to SU. Consider right triangles RSV and RUV. Since RS and RU are radii of the same circle, RS = RU. The triangles share leg RV, and both have right angles at V. By hypotenuse-leg congruence, triangle RSV is congruent to triangle RUV, so SV = VU. From the text, SU = 20, and since SU = SV + VU, each half is 10. Thus SV = 10.
method.CoT_raw: 图像描述：图中是以 R 为圆心的圆，S 和 U 是圆上的点，SU 是右侧的一条弦。点 V 位于弦 SU 上，且从圆心 R 到 V 的线段与 SU 形成直角标记，所以 RV 垂直于 SU。图中还画有另一条弦 YW 及点 X、Z、T，但求 SV 时不需要使用这些信息。推理：考虑直角三角形 RSV 和 RUV。因为 S、U 都在圆上，R 是圆心，所以 RS 和 RU 都是半径，RS = RU。两个三角形还共用直角边 RV，并且在 V 处都是直角。因此根据斜边-直角边 congruence，△RSV ≅ △RUV，所以 SV = VU。已知 SU = 20，而 SU = SV + VU，因此 SV = 20 ÷ 2 = 10。
